gates.name: Official provenance
gates.rule: Every input row carries an https URL on an official domain; recomputation matches the official standings.

gates.name: No look-ahead / walk-forward
gates.rule: All features strictly earlier than the graded game; perturbation test must not change any prediction.

gates.name: Out-of-sample skill
gates.rule: Model Brier strictly below the 0.25 constant-probability baseline and below the static prior model.

gates.name: Break-even edge
gates.rule: Lower bound of the Wilson 95% CI on hit rate must exceed 0.5238 (-110 break-even).

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.rule: Benjamini/Hochberg q <= 0.05 across the whole strategy family.

gates.name: Repeatability
gates.rule: Edge direction positive in both disjoint chronological halves.

gates.name: Correlation control
gates.rule: Parlay / prop-combo legs with |r| >= 0.20 must be priced jointly; same-player legs with |r| >= 0.20 are blocked.

gates.name: Market / closing-line value
gates.rule: Requires an official market price and closing line; no official NFL source publishes betting lines, so this gate fails for every strategy.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Parameters frozen before the first analysis run and committed to the repository.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: All published numbers regenerate from checked-in data + code; every table row has an official source link.

note: G2 and G10 fail for every strategy in this 8-week sample. See Flagged for Review.
